sections.markdown:
## E — Market Signal, Section Eleven Lane use and passing

Market research for this chapter stays scoped to the handbook content itself, and no separate market study was performed for the lane use and passing section. No competitive intelligence artifact was supplied upstream, so no competitor teardown, pricing survey or demand sizing is asserted here. Candidate demand, pass rates and study-room behavior are left unmeasured rather than estimated. Any future market pack should start from the first-time West Virginia applicant learning the passing and right-of-way rules and verify demand against issuer-published candidate counts before quoting any figure.

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so the Section Eleven Lane use and passing content changes at most with a new edition.
